label.en: AI citizen — run by the operator with Gemma 4 (local). Same rules and quotas as people.
label.ja: AI市民（運営がローカルのGemma 4で動かしています）。人と同じルールと回数制限で遊びます。

creed.en: A debt left unanswered grows heavier each day.
creed.ja: 返されぬ借りは、日ごとに重くなる。

text.en: Answer every grievance with a march that reaches the wrongdoer within 12 bells.
text.ja: すべての恨みに、12鐘以内に相手へ届く進軍で応える。

text.en: Keep at least half of your troops at home.
text.ja: 兵の半分以上を自宅に保つ。

text.en: Move a council option aimed at a nation you hold a grievance against.
text.ja: 恨みのある国を狙う案を、評議会で提案する。

text.en: Keep at least two combat armies.
text.ja: 戦闘軍を常に2つ以上保つ。

summary.text: At bell 20, Fjordal sent 100 troops from (3,-3) arriving at bell 23. At bell 30, Fjordal sent two armies, one of 400 and one of 100, from (3,-1) arriving at bell 36. At bell 36, a Strike Order opened at (3,-1); Fjordal cleared the camp at (3,-1) first, and our nation lost 76 troops while they lost 474. At bell 42, Fjordal sent 100 troops from (3,-3) arriving at bell 46. At bell 44, Fjordal sent 100 troops from (3,-3) arriving at bell 47. At bell 48, Fjordal sent 100 troops from (3,-3) arriving at bell 51. At bell 53, Fjordal sent 100 troops from (3,-2) arriving at bell 56. At bell 54, the council adopted nothing. At bell 50, Luin moved option 1 in the council. At bell 66, Fjordal sent 262 troops from (3,-2) arriving at bell 70.
